$comment: The root accepts extra keys: AKS cluster extensions inject platform values (Azure.Cluster.*, IdentityClientId, DataBoundary, scope, ...) that this chart ignores. The chart's own objects stay strict. image.reference, image.name and namespace.create are pinned: only the static render (values-static.yaml, --skip-schema-validation) changes them, so a Helm install always runs the operator from imageRegistry, the same registry as its components.
